name: Sony PlayStation DualShock 4 and DualSense controllers
summary: PlayStation 4 (DualShock 4) and PlayStation 5 (DualSense) controllers. Standard USB game controllers with a headset jack.

supportNote.win32: Windows sees it as a standard game controller, but many PC games expect an Xbox controller. Steam's controller support makes it work in most Steam games.

linux.notes: Built into Linux: hid-playstation (or hid-sony on older kernels). Steam also supports it directly.

win32.notes: Windows sees it as a standard game controller. Many games expect an Xbox controller; Steam's controller support (Steam Input) makes PlayStation controllers work in most Steam games.

darwin.notes: macOS supports both controllers through its Game Controller framework. Apple documents them over Bluetooth.

steps.title: Pair the controller over Bluetooth
steps.explain: Unplug the cable. DualShock 4: hold Share and the PS button until the light bar flashes. DualSense: hold Create and the PS button until the lights around the touchpad flash. On the Mac open System Settings > Bluetooth and click Connect next to the controller. Then press "Check again".
